<b>Redis 命令模式：</b>每行一条命令，遇错即停，<b>没有自动回滚<: Redis command mode: one command per line, execution stops at the first error, no automatic rollback.
<b>Redis 工单：</b>Redis 没有事务回滚，已执行的命令无法自动撤: Redis workflow: Redis has no transactional rollback; commands that have run cannot be undone automatically.
<b>已成功的语句不会回滚</b>，工单变为「执行有异常」，不会自动重试。: Statements that already succeeded are not rolled back. The workflow becomes “Executed with errors” and is not retried automatically.
{user} 在 {time} 选择；SQL 防火墙要求强制脱敏的列仍会脱敏。: Chosen by {user} at {time}; columns the SQL firewall requires to be masked are still masked.
仅超级用户；SQL 防火墙要求强制脱敏的列仍会脱敏: Super users only; columns the SQL firewall requires to be masked are still masked
例如：orders 表加索引: e.g. add an index to the orders table
各实例导出的数据按勾选顺序依次写在同一个文件里（不含实例名称列）。: The data exported from the instances is written to one file in the order the instances were selected (no instance name column).
各实例导出的数据按勾选顺序依次写进同一个文件；各实例返回的列必须一致: The data exported from the instances is written to one file in the order the instances are selected; every instance must return the same columns
例如：财务对账需要核对完整手机号: e.g. Finance reconciliation needs the full phone numbers
导出原值的理由（必填，至少 5 个字，审批人会看到）: Reason for exporting original values (required, at least 5 characters; approvers will see it)
当前不在可执行时间范围内（{start} ～ {end}），立即执行会被拒绝。: The current time is outside the executable window ({start} – {end}); executing now will be rejected.
执行前备份，以便生成回滚语句: Back up before execution so rollback statements can be generated
提交人现在已不是超级用户，执行时不会导出原值，按脱敏设置导出。: The submitter is no longer a super user, so original values will not be exported; the export follows the masking settings.
提交人（超级用户）选择了导出原值，不做数据脱敏: The submitter (a super user) chose to export original values; no data masking is applied
文件已不在存储里: The file is no longer in storage
文件已于 {time} 按保留策略清理，请重新提交导出: The file was purged at {time} per the retention policy. Please submit the export again
无自动回滚（Redis 没有事务回滚）: No automatic rollback (Redis has no transactional rollback)
本级没有可审批的人，仅超级用户可审批，请联系管理员。: No one at this level can approve; only superusers can. Contact an administrator.
标记后工单变为「执行有异常」，<b>不会自动重试</b>，请到目标库核对已执行的: After marking, the workflow becomes “Executed with errors” and will not be retried automatically. Check the target database for statements that have already run.
没有符合条件的导出工单。: No export workflows match the filters.
